content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Faridabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Faridabad?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Teaching Faculty (Super Specialty) posts at ESIC Faridabad is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Faculty (Super Specialty) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 33 vacancies for Teaching Faculty (Super Specialty) posts, including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Teaching Faculty posts is 69 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the ESIC Faridabad recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an evaluation of academic credentials followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Professor post?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for the Professor post is ₹2,63,070/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the required documents for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualification required is as per the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines, specifically the NMC Notification (30/06/2025) on Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for these Teaching Faculty posts is contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ESIC Faridabad office. Specific details regarding the exact venue and reporting time should be confirmed from the official notification.
